blocks.text: Setting up Google Sheets on your Mac

Google Sheets does not have a native Mac application. It lives in your browser. To make it feel like a real app, use the Progressive Web App (PWA) feature in Google Chrome. Open sheets.google.com, click the three-dot menu, select Cast, Save, and Share, and then click Install page as app. This puts an icon in your dock and gives you a dedicated window for your clinical data.
Managing clinical data reconciliation with shortcuts

Reconciliation requires speed. Do not click through menus when you can use keys. Press ⌘ + / to see every available shortcut. Use ⌘ + ⇧ + H to open the find and replace tool for quick data cleaning. Use ⌘ + ⌥ + 9 to hide rows that do not need review. These small habits save hours over a long study.

items: Working in the same sheet as other team members without using filters.
Hard-coding values instead of using formulas for audit trails.
Ignoring the 20 million cell limit for large clinical datasets.
Failing to freeze headers, which makes large datasets hard to read.
Using multiple Google accounts in one browser, which causes permission errors.

blocks.text: Clinical trials generate massive amounts of data. When your sheet slows down, check your formulas. Avoid using volatile functions like INDIRECT or OFFSET if you can. Use QUERY or FILTER instead. If your sheet hits the 20 million cell limit, break your data into multiple files by site or by visit. This keeps your browser responsive and prevents crashes during critical review sessions.
Using Lazur to manage your workspace

As a clinical data manager, you juggle many windows. Lazur helps you stay in the flow. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about a menu item or a setting. If you forget where the freeze row option is, ask Lazur. It will circle the button on your screen so you can click it quickly. Use it to keep your focus on the data, not the interface.

faq.question: Is there a native Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, Google Sheets is a web-based app. You can create a desktop shortcut using the Install page as app feature in Chrome.

faq.question: How do I speed up my data cleaning in Sheets?
faq.answer: Learn the keyboard shortcuts by pressing ⌘ + /. Use the find and replace tool with ⌘ + ⇧ + H and hide unnecessary rows with ⌘ + ⌥ + 9.

faq.question: Why does my spreadsheet lag with large clinical data?
faq.answer: You might be hitting the cell limit or using inefficient formulas. Try to break large datasets into smaller files and avoid volatile functions.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my clinical data?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not edit files. It helps you find tools, guides you through steps, and answers your questions about the interface.
